items.title: Header tail
items.description: Component header-tail: the right end of the header row (the tab row). A divider, the title actions Toggle sidebar and Open folder, a divider, then the window buttons minimize, maximize and close. Used by every workbench frame, so a change here updates all of them. Matches src/workspace/header.rs.

items.title: Window controls
items.description: Component window-controls: the window buttons alone. Used where there are no tabs or title actions, the launch screen header.
